Parse /dca items into the FINBRA long form

Source: R/get_siconfi_taxes.R
parse_siconfi_dca.Rd

items holds one list per item (jsonlite::fromJSON(simplifyVector = FALSE) outlines), with fields exercicio, cod_ibge, uf, instituicao, coluna, cod_conta, valor. The API column labels follow the 2014+ vocabulary for every year. The result carries the attribute reporters: <code_muni> <exercicio> keys of every item, any account; and the attribute context from the current-revenue and tax-revenue items (gross column only). The API's populacao field is ignored: population comes from IBGE (see fetch_siconfi_population()).

Usage

parse_siconfi_dca(items, call = caller_env())
